queries.name: comparable_monthly_yoy_summary
queries.purpose: Show the monthly year-on-year summary for the comparable store population using the business month axis.
queries.intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[Month] for only the comparable stores in resolved_entity_scope.active_comparable_population ('ST4','ST1','ST3','ST2','ST5'), returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], and [bills growth %]. Limit to 15 rows and sort by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[Month] DESC. This uses the business month axis and avoids using 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[max_date] for trading period analysis.

queries.name: latest_load_dates
queries.purpose: Confirm the latest available batch/load dates that frame the reporting cut-off.
queries.intent: Return one row with MAX of 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[max_date], MAX of 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[max_date], and MAX of 'Latest_Refresh_Table'[MaxRefreshDate], with no grouping. This is for reporting cut-off context only and not for daily trading analysis.

queries.name: store_comparable_ranking
queries.purpose: Rank comparable stores by current revenue with current, prior, and growth metrics together.
queries.intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] for only the comparable stores in resolved_entity_scope.active_comparable_population ('ST4','ST1','ST3','ST2','ST5'), returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], and [bills growth %]. Limit to 15 rows and sort by [net revenue CURRENT] DESC.

queries.name: store_month_matrix
queries.purpose: Show which comparable stores drove the most recent monthly revenue positions across months.
queries.intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[Month] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] for only the comparable stores in resolved_entity_scope.active_comparable_population ('ST4','ST1','ST3','ST2','ST5'), returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [net bills CURRENT], and [bills growth]. Limit to 15 row combinations and sort first by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[Month] DESC, then by [net revenue CURRENT] DESC.

queries.name: division_contribution_ranking
queries.purpose: Show the leading divisions by current revenue for the comparable store population at the non-mirrored merchandise level.
queries.intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[division_name] for only the comparable stores in resolved_entity_scope.active_comparable_population ('ST4','ST1','ST3','ST2','ST5'), returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], and [bills growth %]. Limit to 15 rows and sort by [net revenue CURRENT] DESC. Use Division and do not repeat mirrored Department findings.

queries.name: section_contribution_ranking
queries.purpose: Show the leading sections by current revenue for the comparable store population at the non-mirrored merchandise level.
queries.intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[item_category_name] for only the comparable stores in resolved_entity_scope.active_comparable_population ('ST4','ST1','ST3','ST2','ST5'), returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], and [bills growth %]. Limit to 15 rows and sort by [net revenue CURRENT] DESC. Use Section and do not repeat mirrored Category findings.

queries.name: store_by_division_cross
queries.purpose: Identify the largest store-by-division combinations by current revenue within the comparable scope.
queries.intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[division_name] for only the comparable stores in resolved_entity_scope.active_comparable_population ('ST4','ST1','ST3','ST2','ST5'), returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [net bills CURRENT], and [bills growth]. Limit to 15 row combinations and sort by [net revenue CURRENT] DESC.
